notes.content:

[h1]Changes:
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now when the door is open, a hint is shown
[*] Optimization of some objects in LOD
[*] Optimized light sources
[*] About 10% - 15% increase in FPS
[*] Increased brightness
[*] Added the effect of head bob when moving
[*] The character's movement speed has been corrected
[*] Corrected npc movement speed
[*] Added depth of field effect
[*] Corrected camera effects
[*] Fixed indoor sound
[*] Fixed npc behavior
[*] Added musical accompaniment
[*] Changed the musical accompaniment
[*] Level design improvements
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Changes to the textures of the territory
[*] Increasing wind speed
[*] Increasing the speed of clouds
[*] Reduced the area of flight of birds
[*] Grass change correction
[*] Minor optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31710354/c6fc823647bf8397f7cffe3dc5c9e21eaaccbe1a.jpg[/img]

Dear players, we have introduced a test mode joint passage of the game. Please report any bugs to us. To start playing you need Library -> One Night On The Road -> Play -> Multiplayer (Test). All changes came only to the branch with multiplayer.


Update:

-Add Voice chat (button V)
-Fix street lights
-Add skip start scane
-Lighting changes
-Add Multiplayer
